summary: The Acer Predator Neo 16 (RTX 4050) is experiencing a GPU power delivery issue, resulting in glitches, crashes, and instability. The problem is exacerbated by battery power, but only works when plugged in and set to “Maximum Performance” mode.
detected_fault: VRAM power delivery failure rather than a dead core
suggested_solution: Replace MOSFETs and capacitors from AliExpress to rebuild the power delivery section
